name: BYOM behavioral checks (streaming / structured / multi-turn / parity / concurrent / retry)
summary: Cross-cutting BYOM correctness probes on the Responses API — streaming, JSON-schema structured output, multi-turn retention, static-vs-dynamic parity, concurrency, and retry-after-429.
description: The `aoai.responses.create(model='{connection}/{deployment}', ...)` BYOM path must preserve the gateway-prefixed model across Responses API behaviors such as SSE streaming, `response_format=json_schema`, multi-turn conversations, parallel calls, and rate-limit handling. These checks protect users from regressions in common request shapes that sit below agents and tools.
notes:
Verified end-to-end across the Responses API behavior checks. See `test.py`.

The rate-limit backoff probe is best-effort because it only observes APIM throttling when the canary environment returns a 429. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway.
